subject: Eval boarding checklist & cutover conduct — CareBridge MAP
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Mendez <elena@carebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Eval boarding checklist & cutover conduct — CareBridge MAP

Hi Elena / pilot team,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I put together a concise boarding checklist and the proposed cutover conduct so we have a single playbook for the evaluation phase and the staged close. Goal here is to reduce ambiguity during the pilot so your engineering and security teams know exactly what will be measured and when we consider the MAP milestones satisfied.

Key points up front:
- Measurement window: 2-week pilot running on a 1000-request sample (canonical prompts + live traffic slice)
- Stability gates: 48-hour smoke window with continuous monitoring, then a 7-day canary at 25% traffic
- Quality gate: relevance >= 92% on the seeded eval set; hallucination rate < 2% across the same set
- Performance gate: p50 latency < 220ms, p95 < 520ms for your median request size (512 tokens) under expected concurrency

Attached: eval-test-suite.md (test plan + scoring rubric) and carebridge-map-v2.xlsx (mutual action plan with owners/dates). Please review the owners column — I assigned initial owners based on our notes but leave flexible for your team.

Boarding checklist (owners & due dates):
1) Instrumentation (Elena / CareBridge) — telemetry hooks + sample logging (due Oct 15)
2) Security review (Marissa / Redwood + CareBridge infosec) — list of artifacts and evidence (due Oct 18)
3) Smoke run (Soojin / CareBridge eng) — 48-hour run with automated alerts (Oct 20–22)
4) Data retention & privacy confirmation (Legal / CareBridge) — retention window and KMS requirements (Oct 18)
5) Canary cut (Ben / Redwood) — 7 days at 25% traffic once smoke is green (target start Oct 25)

Acceptance & exit criteria (short):
- Acceptance: All measurement gates pass and no critical security findings.
- Soft-fail / rollback: If any stability gate breaches (error rate spike > 1.5x baseline) we pause and revert to baseline routing for at least 24 hrs.
- Final go/no-go: Joint sign-off from CareBridge product lead + Redwood strategic AE after canary completion.

Next steps I need from you this week:
- Confirm the instrumentation owner and whether we can get a sample traffic dump by Oct 14.
- Legal ask: confirm the required retention period and whether the security team needs on-prem evidence before we start the smoke.

I'll queue a quick 30-min alignment tomorrow to walk through the XLS and the test-suite. If that works, I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0172

From: Elena Mendez <elena@carebridge.com>

Cc: pilot-team@carebridge.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval boarding checklist & cutover conduct — CareBridge MAP

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear breakdown. This looks good and I appreciate the short, measurable gates. A few notes from our side:

1) Instrumentation — I can own the telemetry hooks but my lead engineer (cc'd to pilot-team) will need 48 hours to validate schema. We should target providing a sanitized sample traffic file by Oct 16 rather than the 14th.
2) Security — our compliance team wants a quick read on the KMS key rotation policy before we sign off on the smoke run. I'll attach our internal checklist (see attached carebridge-compliance-checklist.pdf).
3) Canary timing — can we move the canary start one week later (target Oct 30) to accommodate our release calendar? That gives us buffer for legal review.

A couple of clarifying questions on the acceptance metrics: what does "relevance >= 92%" map to in the rubric? Is that a mean score across the 100 seeded prompts or a median? Also — for hallucination rate: are you measuring false entity assertions or hallucinated sensitive facts?

If you and Marissa are OK with the small timing shift I mentioned, I can confirm owners and get the sample traffic file to you on Oct 16.

Elena

--
Elena Mendez | Head of AI Integrations
CareBridge Health
elena@carebridge.com

Attachments:
- carebridge-compliance-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Looping in a quick commercial note so the evaluation/canary plan maps to procurement expectations.

- MAP credit offer: We commit 30k usage credits for the 30-day evaluation tied to this MAP (documented in HubSpot). If the canary moves to full production within 90 days, we will convert to a standard reserved capacity conversation.
- SLA: The pilot will run on our standard ingestion SLA; any bespoke latency SLOs (strict low-p95 targets) will need an uplift to dedicated capacity. Happy to model the cost impact once we have the 7-day canary numbers.
- DocuSign: I've uploaded the MAP terms with the evaluation credit stub to DocuSign — link below. We can route the signature to Elena + CareBridge legal.

Operational ask for Soojin / Marissa: if security needs on-prem evidence before smoke, confirm whether we can provide scoped audit logs (redacted) or whether they require a vendor attestation. That will affect the legal timeline and the canary start.

Ben

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval boarding checklist & cutover conduct — CareBridge MAP

Thanks for the fast responses — great questions, Elena. Quick clarifications and updated timeline below.

On metrics: the relevance >= 92% is a mean score across the seeded eval set (we compute top-1 relevance using your scorer in eval-test-suite.md). Hallucination rate is measured by the test-suite's fact-checking step: any asserted fact not present in the ground truth is flagged; we count unique hallucinated assertions divided by total assertions. The rubric in eval-test-suite.md has explicit examples.

Updated timeline (agreed adjustments):
- Oct 16: CareBridge provides sanitized sample traffic (instrumentation validation)
- Oct 18: Security checklist responses due; Redwood to provide redacted audit logs if CareBridge prefers attestation first
- Oct 20–22: 48-hour smoke run (instrumentation + alerts); pass -> proceed
- Oct 30–Nov 5: 7-day canary at 25% traffic (moved per Elena request)
- Nov 6: Joint review & MAP signature (if gates green) -> move to production onboarding and reserve-sizing conversation

Contingency / rollback play: any critical security finding (severity P1) or sustained error-rate >1.5x baseline during smoke triggers immediate pause and a joint incident review within 4 hours.

I will:
- Send a calendar invite for a 30-min alignment tomorrow (Oct 14) to walk through the XLS and scoring rubric.
- Publish the test-suite scoring script we run internally to the shared doc (link in related_links).
- Kick the DocuSign to Elena's legal (Ben, thanks for uploading).

If this reads OK I'll mark the owners column as final in carebridge-map-v2.xlsx and we can treat the MAP as actionable.

--
Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
